top_choice_rationale: P001 rests on a continuous, independently confirmed chain from human incretin physiology and proglucagon processing to the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide and to drugs with randomized outcome evidence in glycaemia, weight, cardiovascular and renal endpoints. The hormone-and-active-form citation keeps the award in physiology or medicine, and the discovery is mature. Credit for the active peptide (Mojsov versus Habener) and the omission of Knudsen remain weak points, but they do not outweigh the achievement, so no award ranks below it.
